mapper.insert: INSERT INTO group_purchase (member_id, product_name, category, image, unit_price, group_price, delivery_method, delivery_fee, delivery_date, delivery_estimate_days, description, target_quantity, deadline) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{productName}, #{category}, #{image}, #{unitPrice}, #{groupPrice}, #{deliveryMethod}, #{deliveryFee}, #{deliveryDate}, #{deliveryEstimateDays}, #{description}, #{targetQuantity}, #{deadline})
mapper.update: UPDATE group_purchase SET current_quantity = current_quantity - #{quantity} WHERE gp_id = #{gpId} AND current_quantity - #{quantity} >= 0 AND current_quantity < target_quantity AND deadline >= NOW() AND status != 'CANCELLED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO group_purchase_participant (gp_id, member_id, purchase_quantity, recipient_name, recipient_phone, zip_code, address, address_detail, paid_amount, payment_status, paid_at, txn_id) VALUES (#{gpId}, #{memberId}, #{quantity}, #{recipientName}, #{recipientPhone}, #{zipCode}, #{address}, #{addressDetail}, #{paidAmount}, #{paymentStatus}, #{paidAt}, #{txnId})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM group_purchase_participant WHERE gp_id = #{gpId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND payment_status != 'CANCELLED'

SELECT gp.* FROM group_purchase gp JOIN group_purchase_participant gpp ON gpp.gp_id = gp.gp_id WHERE gpp.member_id = #{memberId} AND gpp.payment_status != 'CANCELLED'
AND gp.status != 'CANCELLED' AND gp.current_quantity < gp.target_quantity AND gp.deadline >= NOW()
AND gp.status != 'CANCELLED' AND gp.current_quantity >= gp.target_quantity
